exposure: LUS and myometrium measurements by ultrasound
lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness of 1.0 mm or less
vaginal delivery at full-term vs repeat CS at preterm
cohort: 107 pregnant women with previous CS and LUS thickness of 1.0 mm or less
finding: Ultrasound has high sensitivity and specificity for pregnant women with previous CS in detecting LUS dehiscence and rupture.
